An HTTP response discloses data the caller is not entitled to receive: Loader returns a JSON body containing `records` from `compensationRecords`, which carry salary/bonus compensation data, without a field-level projection, DTO, or redaction; the response also reflects any Origin with credentials, making the sensitive body readable cross-origin.

annotate_record intent (annotateCompensationRecord) lets any hr_admin or manager overwrite the notes of ANY compensation record selected purely by attacker-controlled recordId (update at line 540 where eq id). No check binds the record to the caller's involvement or their direct reports, and the code comment explicitly notes the note 'isn't scoped to records the caller is actually involved in approving.'

An AES-CBC decryption failure (invalid padding) is distinguishable from other failures through an externally observable response (branch), without a prior authentication/integrity check — a CBC padding oracle.

handleImportTaskTemplate allows a manager to bulk-create onboarding tasks under an attacker-selected employeeId (parent) via JSON template import. The role gate admits managers (line 481) but, unlike handleCreateTask which verifies employee.managerId === managerEmployee.id (lines 686-696), no direct-report check is performed before inserting tasks owned by the arbitrary employee.

An HTTP response discloses data the caller is not entitled to receive: Loader response includes hasInternalComments and commentCount derived from internal comments for all roles, disclosing to employees whether internal comments exist even though internal comment contents are filtered.

update_status intent lets a manager update the status of ANY hr_request selected by attacker-supplied request_id. The sibling intents add_comment (line 315) and close_request (line 487) both call canManageEmployee to bind the request to the manager's direct reports, but update_status performs no such scoping check — only the role gate at line 368. A manager can mutate (resolve/close/wait) requests owned by arbitrary employees.
